appName.description: Extension name shown in the toolbar and the Web Store.

appDesc.message: Find free time in your Google Calendar automatically
appDesc.description: Extension description shown in the Web Store.

loginDesc.message: Connect your Google Calendar to find free time

connectedInfo.description: Shown after Google Calendar access is granted.

switchAccountBtn.description: Button that signs in with a different Google account.

logoutBtn.description: Button that signs the user out.

legendCalendars.description: Legend of the calendar selection fieldset.

labelDuration.description: Label for the minimum length of a free slot.

searchRangeHeading.description: Heading of the date range section.

labelStart.description: Label for the start date input.

labelEnd.description: Label for the end date input.

prevWeekBtn.description: Navigation button. Keep the arrow first.

prevDayBtn.description: Navigation button. Keep the arrow first.

nextDayBtn.description: Navigation button. Keep the arrow first.

nextWeekBtn.description: Navigation button. Keep the arrow first.

todayBadge.description: Badge shown when the displayed day is today.

copyAllBtn.message: Copy all slots for this day
copyAllBtn.description: Button that copies every slot of the day.

privacyPolicy.description: Footer link to the privacy policy.

privacyPolicyUrl.description: URL of the privacy policy page for this language. Both pages describe the same implementation.

ariaSearchRange.description: aria-label of the search range section.

ariaPresets.description: aria-label of the preset button group.

conditionsToggle.description: Collapsible heading, shown without a date range.

conditionsToggleWithRange.description: Collapsible heading with the selected date range. $1 = range such as 7/24-7/31.

weekdaysShort.description: Comma separated weekday abbreviations, starting with Sunday. Exactly 7 items.

monthsShort.description: Comma separated month names, starting with January. Exactly 12 items.

dateHeader.description: Compact date in the navigation. $1 month, $2 day, $3 weekday, $4 month name, $5 year.

dateShort.description: Date used in copied text. $1 month, $2 day, $3 weekday, $4 month name, $5 year.

dateFull.description: Full date on the result card. $1 month, $2 day, $3 weekday, $4 month name, $5 year.

rangeFormat.description: Range separator used for both time ranges (10:00-11:00) and date ranges (7/24-7/31). $1 = start, $2 = end.

slotCount.description: Free slot count line. %%VALUE%% is replaced with slotCountValue, rendered in bold.

slotCountValue.description: Bold part of the free slot count. $1 = number of slots.

noAvailability.description: Shown when a day has no free slot.

copied.description: Shown after a slot is copied.

copiedAll.description: Shown after every slot is copied.

copyFailed.description: Shown when copying fails. $1 = error message.

addToCalendar.description: Button that opens the Google Calendar event editor.

authDenied.message: Access to Google Calendar was denied

authNotSignedIn.message: You are not signed in to Google. Please sign in to your Google Account in Chrome

authFailed.message: Sign-in failed. Please try again later

calNoPermission.message: You do not have permission to access Google Calendar

networkError.message: Network error. Please check your connection

needDates.message: Please select a start and end date

invalidDateOrder.message: Start date must be on or before the end date

rangeTooLong.message: The date range must be 31 days or less

searchNotStarted.description: Shown when a search cannot begin.

calFetchFailed.description: Shown when the calendar list cannot be loaded.

searchFailed.message: Could not find free time. Please try again

weekNavDisabled.message: Week navigation is unavailable in range search
weekNavDisabled.description: Tooltip and toast for the week buttons.

boundarySingle.description: Position label when the range is one day.

atFirstDay.message: This is the first day of the range

atLastDay.message: This is the last day of the range

periodPosition.description: Position line during a range search. $1 = position such as 3 / 7, $2 = boundary label.

linkFailed.message: Could not link your Sukima account

linkExpired.message: Your link expired. Please try again

quotaLimitReached.message: You have used all 3 free searches for this week.

quotaRetry.message: Could not start the search. Please try again.
